lines.gurmukhi: ਪਸਰੀ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਰਸਿ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੇ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pasaree kiran ras kamal bigaase sas ghar soor samaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The rays of light spread out, and the heart-lotus joyfully blossoms forth; the sun enters into the house of the moon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਧੁੰਸਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kaal bidhu(n)s manasaa man maaree gur prasaad prabh paaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: I have conquered death; the desires of the mind are destroyed. By Guru's Grace, I have found God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: at ras ra(n)g chaloolai raatee doojaa ra(n)g na koee ||
lines.translation: I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love. I am not colored by any other color.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਿ ਰਸਾਏ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak rasan rasaae raate rav rahiaa prabh soee ||4||15||
lines.translation: O Nanak, my tongue is saturated with the taste of God, who is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਵਲ ਖਪਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਚਹੁ ਛਿਅ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: baarah mahi raaval khap jaavahi chahu chhi mahi sa(n)niaasee ||
lines.translation: The Yogis are divided into twelve schools, the Sannyaasees into ten.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਸਿਰਖੂਥੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jogee kaapaReeaa sirakhoothe bin sabadai gal phaasee ||1||
lines.translation: The Yogis and those wearing religious robes, and the Jains with their all hair plucked out - without the Word of the Shabad, the noose is around their necks. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad rate poore bairaagee ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the Shabad are the perfectly detached renunciates.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਹਠਿ ਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਜਾਚੀ ਏਕ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: auhath hasat mahi bheekhiaa jaachee ek bhaai liv laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: They beg to receive charity in the hands of their hearts, embracing love and affection for the One. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਵਾਦੁ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahaman vaad paRahi kar kiriaa karanee karam karaae ||
lines.translation: The Brahmins study and argue about the scriptures; they perform ceremonial rituals, and lead others in these rituals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin boojhe kichh soojhai naahee manamukh vichhuR dukh paae ||2||
lines.translation: Without true understanding, those self-willed manmukhs understand nothing. Separated from God, they suffer in pain. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਚਾਚਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad mile se soochaachaaree saachee daragah maane ||
lines.translation: Those who receive the Shabad are sanctified and pure; they are approved in the True Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anadin naam ratan liv laage jug jug saach samaane ||3||
lines.translation: Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the Naam; throughout the ages, they are merged in the True One. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagale karam dharam such sa(n)jam jap tap teerath sabad vase ||
lines.translation: Good deeds, righteousness and Dharmic faith, purification, austere self-discipline, chanting, intense meditation and pilgrimages to sacred shrines - all these abide in the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਦੂਖ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਕਾਲ ਨਸੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur milai milaaiaa dookh paraachhat kaal nase ||4||16||
lines.translation: O Nanak, united in union with the True Guru, suffering, sin and death run away. ||4||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)taa kee ren saadh jan sa(n)gat har keerat tar taaree ||
lines.translation: The dust of the feet of the Saints, the Company of the Holy, and the Praises of the Lord carry us across to the other side.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa karai bapuraa jam darapai guramukh ridai muraaree ||1||
lines.translation: What can the wretched, terrified Messenger of Death do to the Gurmukhs? The Lord abides in their hearts. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal jaau jeevan naam binaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, life might just as well be burnt down.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jap jaap japau japamaalee guramukh aavai saad manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh chants and meditates on the Lord, chanting the chant on the mala; the Flavor of the Lord comes into the mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur upades saach sukh jaa kau kiaa tis upamaa kaheeai ||
lines.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings find true peace - how can I even describe the glory of such a person?

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਖੋਜਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: laal javehar ratan padaarath khojat guramukh laheeai ||2||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh seeks and finds the gems and jewels, diamonds, rubies and treasures. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੀਨੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਚੌ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: cheenai giaan dhiaan dhan saachau ek sabad liv laavai ||
lines.translation: So center yourself on the treasures of spiritual wisdom and meditation; remain lovingly attuned to the One True Lord, and the Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬੁ ਨਿਰਹਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: niraala(n)b nirahaar nihakeval nirabhau taaRee laavai ||3||
lines.translation: Remain absorbed in the Primal State of the Fearless, Immaculate, Independent, Self-sufficient Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰ ਸਪਤ ਭਰੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਉਲਟੀ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saair sapat bhare jal niramal ulatee naav taraavai ||
lines.translation: The seven seas are overflowing with the Immaculate Water; the inverted boat floats across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਤੌ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: baahar jaatau thaak rahaavai guramukh sahaj samaavai ||4||
lines.translation: The mind which wandered in external distractions is restrained and held in check; the Gurmukh is intuitively absorbed in God. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so girahee so daas udaasee jin guramukh aap pachhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: He is a householder, he is a renunciate and God's slave, who, as Gurmukh, realizes his own self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੫॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai avar nahee doojaa saach sabad man maaniaa ||5||17||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, his mind is pleased and appeased by the True Word of the Shabad; there is no other at all. ||5||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag prabhaatee mahalaa 3 chaupade ||
lines.translation: Raag Prabhaatee, Third Mehl, Chau-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh viralaa koee boojhai sabade rahiaa samaaee ||
lines.translation: Those who become Gurmukh and understand are very rare; God is permeating and pervading through the Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam rate sadaa sukh paavai saach rahai liv laaee ||1||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, find everlasting peace; they remain lovingly attuned to the True One. ||1||
